name: Behari Lal Engineering Limited
summary: Behari Lal Engineering Limited engages in the manufacturing and trading of iron and steel products in India. The company manufactures metal rolls for rolling mills across various grades including alloy cast steel rolls, alloy steel base adamite rolls, graphitic steel rolls, S. G. Iron Pearlitic Rolls, S. G. Iron Bainitic/Accicular Rolls, alloyed indefinite chill rolls, and forged rolls used in rolling processes to produce finished steel products such as TMT rebar and structural steel. It also offers engineering castings in various grades for industries including steel, iron, mining and aggregate crushers, power, and sugar; carbon, alloy steel, tool steel, valve steel, and stainless steel bar…
